# Chargeback Analysis: Consumer Disputes and Fraud drove holiday period dispute volume increases

| Reason Category | Disputes (avg/mo) | Disputed $ (avg/mo) | Win Rate | Friendly Fraud Rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Consumer Disputes | 333 [F1] | $619K [F1] | 55.7% [F1] | 0.0% [F1] |
| Fraud | 201 [F3] | $375K [F3] | 33.1% [F3] | 100.0% [F3] |
| Processing Errors | 40 [F5] | $72K [F5] | 50.9% [F5] | 0.0% [F5] |

- **Consumer Disputes** surged 59% from 210 [F2] to 333 disputes/month [F1] during the holiday period, with disputed amounts rising 67% from $371K [F2] to $619K [F1]; win rate improved marginally to 55.7% [F1] from 53.0% [F2] (latest month win rate covers resolved disputes only)

- **Fraud** disputes increased 60% from 126 [F4] to 201/month [F3], with dollars rising 63% from $231K [F4] to $375K [F3]; all disputes flagged as friendly fraud (100.0% [F3], [F4]) but win rate declined to 33.1% [F3] from 35.5% [F4]

- **Processing Errors** grew 54% from 26 [F6] to 40 disputes/month [F5] with amounts up 44% from $50K [F6] to $72K [F5]; win rate declined to 50.9% [F5] from 53.4% [F6]

## Data Coverage
Nov 2025-Jan 2026 vs Aug-Oct 2025; CFPB complaints: 5,110/month [F1] and 4,676/month [F2] market-wide benchmarks
